evaluation.target_region: Private evaluator-only bounding rectangle of all visible calyx bboxes of current target per frozen trajectory. Never public ROI.
evaluation.target_false_positive_policy: Match globally in confidence order against all visible native GT at IoU>=0.5 first. Ignore predictions matched to other plants even if class is wrong. For unmatched predictions count target FP only when predicted mask centroid falls within the private bounding rectangle enclosing all visible calyx bboxes of current target per frozen trajectory. If the target is not visible, target FP is zero; all-object metrics remain reported.
evaluation.claims: Appearance of capacho, not internal fruit maturity; engineering size criterion, not universal YOLO limit.
evaluation.target_matching_order: Global class-agnostic one-to-one matching before selecting current target per frozen trajectory.
evaluation.target_eligible_policy: Ignore matched instances of current target per frozen trajectory below 100 native visible pixels or 8 pixel minimum bbox side; do not rematch excluded predictions.

video_contract.main: drone RGB with predicted masks and track IDs
video_contract.inset: synchronized third-person view of current frames only; presentation proxy never inference
